protocol.history: full cached tape signed before settlement selection
protocol.units: probability price per share; multiply 100 for cents per share
protocol.day_boundary: UTC day start <= ts < next UTC day start minus 5 minutes
protocol.price_support: finite print price and forward midpoint in [0,1]
protocol.common_rows: all four rules and truth signed, finite positive print share size
protocol.economic_meaning: delivered-quote signed accounting, not causal impact/private information or net profitability
protocol.forward_quote_limitation: forward quote timestamp/bid/ask absent; age, crossing and two-sided state unverified; cutoff cannot repair internal outages
protocol.statistics: equal-day descriptive mean/range on selected dependent dates; daily asset ranks have no independent-asset inference
protocol.sign_zero_definition: abs(mean)<=1e-12 price units counts as numerical zero for sign diagnostics; raw means retained
protocol.rank_precision_definition: round asset means to 12 decimal places only for rank-input ties; raw accounting means retained; no economic materiality threshold

asset_exploratory.interpretation: daily asset means; assets share markets/events; descriptive, no independent-asset inference

quote_age_1s.selection: primary rows with 0 <= delivered current quote age <= 1000 ms

tie_exclusion.selection: exclude tied primary scoring rows; full signing history retained

unique_hash.selection: first cache-row-id among primary eligible rows for each transaction hash; full signing history retained

chain_price.selection: primary rows with valid chain_price; fixed signs and print share weights
